subject: Behavioral expectations and remediation log — R. Malhotra
messages:
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Behavioral expectations and next steps (R. Malhotra)

Hi Laura, Vivek, Rishi —

Following our 1:1 earlier this week, I'm documenting the concern areas and proposed short remediation cadence so we have a clear record and aligned expectations. I want to be transparent: this is meant to support Rishi and avoid a formal PIP if we see steady improvement; if not, we'll follow HR escalation steps.

Summary of specific concerns (examples attached):
- Timeliness: multiple missed deadlines on the model onboarding tasks (see examples in attached PDF).
- Communication: late status updates and limited visibility into blockers; this led to two missed syncs and a surprise outage handoff last month.
- Prioritization: tendency to scope too broadly for sprint commitments leading to repeated scope carryover.

Proposed remediation plan (trial window: 4 weeks) — measurable and check-in focused:
1) Priorities and commitments: Rishi to publish a weekly sprint commitment doc each Monday by 10am and tag me; commitments limited to agreed story points.
2) Daily stand flag: quick Slack stand each morning (5 bullets) documenting blockers; expect proactive escalation within same day for anything blocking progress.
3) Deliverable checkpoints: mid-week informal sync on Wednesdays (15 minutes) to review progress on committed tasks.
4) Visibility: update the task board with clear ACs and acceptance criteria before EOD of the owning day.

Consequences and evaluation: if these steps are followed and we see measurable improvement (on-time delivery on committed items, consistent daily flags, fewer unplanned escalations) we will close the remediation window with written confirmation. If not, we will convert to a formal PIP after the 4-week window.

Action items:
- Rishi: please acknowledge receipt and confirm you can start Monday 6/14 (I recognize 6/10 is short notice; the timeline is flexible but we'd like to begin by next week).
- Vivek: please advise if you want different KPIs or an alternate reviewer for check-ins.
- Laura: copying for HR awareness and documentation. I attached the concrete examples I referenced.

Attachments: 2026-06-10_rmalhotra_examples.pdf (summary of missed items and timestamps)

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Director, Product Platform
